party_basis: the last party primary each voter voted in (2020-2026)
party_methods_note: Party (the last party primary each voter voted in) is shown for all ballots combined; it isn't split by voting method, so this view is turnout only.

party_hints.cast: Everyone who has voted so far, by the last party primary they voted in (2020-2026), as matched by theoelections.com from the counties' early-voting rosters. No party = no primary since 2020, including new voters.

unk_label: counted, but not yet on the rosters matched to primary history
map_note: In-person early votes for 9 counties (Bell, Dallas, Ellis, Hays, Hockley, Madison, McLennan, Montgomery, Travis) come from the county's own live turnout page (updated through the day). Harris's in-person early votes come from the county's own early-voting report, posted each voting evening (ahead of the state's next-morning figure). Every other county's come from the Secretary of State's daily report, which adds each day's in-person votes the next morning, so during the day those counties lag behind. Party is the last party primary each voter voted in (2020-2026), from theoelections.com's match of the counties' early-voting rosters to primary voting history (218 counties, 533,218 voters as of 2026-10-20); ballots not on those rosters yet, such as today's in-person votes, count as party not reported. Where the rosters count more voters than the state's report, the extra voters are added: Denton 38,462 (state 37,959), Williamson 28,239 (state 12,791), El Paso 22,411 (state 1,487), Hidalgo 21,692 (state 20,880), Montgomery 19,059 (state 18,744), Hays 12,113 (state 10,737), Cameron 10,092 (state 9,429), Ellis 8,873 (state 8,835).

source.primary: Texas Secretary of State, Election Information & Turnout Data (unofficial early voting turnout by county, as submitted by county election officials)

party_history.label: theoelections.com (early voters by last party primary)
